title: Thalamic local field potentials during reading aloud of words and nonwords (Wang et al., 2022): 11 essential tremor patients, DBS surgery (derivative: preprocessed epochs)
description: Preprocessed, epoched local field potentials from the ventral lateral thalamus of 11 essential tremor patients undergoing awake deep brain stimulation (DBS) lead implantation. Patients read aloud consonant-vowel-consonant words and nonwords while activity was recorded from mapping-electrode macrocontacts or implanted DBS leads. This derivative repackages the authors' preprocessed trials from the Dryad release into BIDS iEEG format, with contact coordinates in MNI space and trial-level bad-trial annotations.
methods_description: Recordings were made intraoperatively with Neuro Omega (Alpha Omega) mapping electrodes in 4 patients and with Medtronic 3387 DBS leads on a Ripple Grapevine system in 7 patients. The authors' preprocessing comprised a 60 Hz notch filter, resampling to 1 kHz, 400 Hz low-pass and 2 Hz high-pass filtering, and epoching around each trial. Contacts were localized with Lead-DBS and normalized to MNI ICBM152 NLIN 2009b space.
